title: Add front/back nine subtotals and PDF leaderboard export

requirements.summary: Display a subtotal for holes 1-9 (front nine) in each player's score entry card
acceptanceCriteria: Front nine subtotal appears in the golfer score entry card after hole 9
Subtotal updates automatically as scores are entered or modified
Subtotal is clearly labeled as 'Front 9' or 'Holes 1-9'

file_operations.description: Add front nine subtotal calculation and display within each golfer's score entry card. Calculate the sum of holes 1-9 and render it in a clearly labeled section after hole 9's input field. Ensure the subtotal updates reactively as scores are entered or modified. Position the subtotal to visually separate the front nine from holes 10-18 when applicable.

requirements.summary: Display a subtotal for holes 10-18 (back nine) in each player's score entry card
acceptanceCriteria: Back nine subtotal appears in the golfer score entry card after hole 18
Subtotal updates automatically as scores are entered or modified
Subtotal is clearly labeled as 'Back 9' or 'Holes 10-18'
Back nine subtotal only displays when the event is configured for 18 holes

file_operations.description: Add back nine subtotal calculation and display within each golfer's score entry card. Calculate the sum of holes 10-18 and render it in a clearly labeled section after hole 18's input field. Ensure the subtotal only displays when the event is configured for 18 holes. The subtotal must update reactively as scores are entered or modified. Position it after the last hole input to complete the score entry card.

requirements.summary: Add a PDF generation feature to the leaderboard view that exports the calculated standings to PDF format
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Generate PDF' or 'Export PDF' button appears on the leaderboard view
Clicking the button generates a PDF containing the complete leaderboard with all player standings
PDF includes tournament details (title, course, date)
PDF shows rankings, player names, gross scores, net scores, and Callaway adjustments
PDF formatting is clean and print-ready

file_operations.description: Create a new PDF export utility function that generates a print-optimized HTML view of the leaderboard standings. Include tournament details (title, course, date), complete rankings with player names, gross scores, net scores, and Callaway adjustments. Format the output to be clean and print-ready. Follow the pattern established in exportStandingsPdf.ts but adapt it for the leaderboard format. Open the generated HTML in a new window to trigger the browser's native print-to-PDF functionality.

Add a 'Generate PDF' or 'Export PDF' button to the leaderboard view interface. Wire the button to call the exportLeaderboardPdf utility function created in the previous step, passing the computed Callaway results and event configuration data. Position the button prominently near the leaderboard table for easy access. Ensure the button is only enabled when results are available.
